column1: How many passport applications were stuck when Tinubu took office, and what happened?
column2: A backlog of 204,332 passports, cleared by 5 October 2023.
column3: One of the first quick wins for ordinary Nigerians.

column1: Can Nigerians abroad renew passports without going to an embassy?
column2: Yes. The contactless biometric renewal system had processed over 15,000 passports by September 2025.
column3: Our diaspora no longer has to travel long distances or queue for days.

column1: How long is the new enhanced e-passport valid?
column2: There is now a 10-year validity option, with polycarbonate security features, online payment and application tracking.
column3: Fewer renewals, less touting, more security.

column1: What regional leadership role did Tinubu hold?
column2: Chairman of the ECOWAS Authority of Heads of State: elected 9 July 2023 and re-elected 7 July 2024.
column3: His fellow West African leaders trusted Nigeria to lead the region twice.

column2: Diplomacy built on Democracy, Development, Demography and Diaspora, linking foreign policy to jobs, investment and Nigerians abroad.
column3: Diplomacy that works for Nigerians at home and abroad.

column1: How many verified projects did the Special Duties ministry certify across the six zones?
column2: 772 intervention and constituency projects verified and certified for 2023–2025 (June 2026).
column3: Projects are being checked on the ground, not just announced.
